text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Crown, you should come
to Hong Kong next!

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
I know that no matter where you go, you'll run just as brilliantly!
(I agree! You can run anywhere!)

text_block_list.name: Crown's Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"...Before that, Milady must first overcome the obstacle before her eyes.
(……その前に。
お嬢様は目先の難関を越えましょう)"

text_block_list.name: Crown's Instructor
text_block_list.text:
我哋甚麼時候都會一直支持住你㗎。
(We will always be on your side, no matter what.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
……。
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Indeed.
That's right—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Because I am your daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Words of encouragement from your father, I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They said they would watch today's race too.
Despite their busy schedule... doing so for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Your words are more than I deserve.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it begins! The "Japanese Derby"!
Which Umamusume will seize the title of Japan's best?!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
The attendance has already surpassed 100,000.
It looks like they'll be battling down the home stretch amid deafening cheers.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
On this grand stage where excitement runs high,
a key point to watch is whether they can stay composed throughout the race
without being overwhelmed by waves of nerves and anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
This will be a battle that tests both
your body and spirit, forged as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, it looks like the odds have been updated.
Whoa, these results are... I see."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's popularity really is rock-solid.
That late burst of speed she showed at the Satsuki Sho
was truly heroic. An astounding run.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the other Umamusume running are conscious of her too. After all—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: "—Because in this generation, one cannot become the best in Japan without surpassing her."

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. You can do it!
You even set a personal best over these past two months!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Trainerrr...
I-I-I-I'm... uwaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... It makes you nervous, doesn't it?
In any other year, she might have actually had
a shot at winning the Derby, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
All these monsters gathered in the very same year.
...Of course you'd feel like crying.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Nonsense, surely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "An Umamusume who can cry here isn't weak. Those tears are proof that, even now, she still wants to win."
choice_data_list: ...Then are you going to cry now too?
...Then are you going to cry now too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want me to cry?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's right. The pre-race preparations she makes are completely different from my own.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Let us make sure to expend the energy we saved up for today at just the right moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I will be the one
to triumph in this generation.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: So you've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
The Derby is a stage where I must seize victory no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Shall we shake on it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will claim the title of Derby Uma Musume this year?!
The Nippon Derby begins!!
